title: Non-Maximum Suppression
learning_objectives: Return kept indices in score order
hints: Order: `idx = np.argsort(-scores, kind='stable')`, then filter by score threshold.
Write an `_iou(box, many)` helper (or reuse CV-23).
Loop: `i = order[0]`; keep it; `order = order[1:][iou(boxes[i], boxes[order[1:]]) <= t]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Compare remaining boxes with each newly kept box, not only with the first box.
Return indices in the order they were kept (descending score).
Drop boxes below score_threshold before suppression.
Use a stable sort so equal scores keep the lower index first.
